_about: Curated map from original sources to readable wiki notes. The harness reads this during ingest: each note gets its excerpts from the listed source sections, a Gemma-written summary, and the related links below. Filenames come from 'title', so re-ingesting overwrites the same note instead of creating a duplicate.
